name: context-guard
description: Runs the /clear at the end of the guardrails handoff chain: once the handoff is written it clears the session and continues from it, carrying over a prompt typed meanwhile. It also warns as the context grows and blocks new prompts past a limit.

warn_tokens.title: Warn at (tokens)
warn_tokens.description: Context size at which each prompt gets a note for Claude and a line for you. Default 180000.

block_tokens.title: Block prompts at (tokens)
block_tokens.description: Context size at which prompts are dropped, except slash commands, shell escapes and prompts that mention a handoff. Keep it below your auto-compact window (280000 for the default 300000), or it never fires. Default 260000.
